items.summary: The U.S. Navy has officially commissioned the USS Ted Stevens (DDG 128), its newest Flight III Arleigh Burke-class guided-missile destroyer equipped with the SPY-6 radar and Aegis Baseline 10, during a ceremony in Whittier, Alaska. The U.S. Navy placed its newest Flight III Arleigh Burke-class guided-missile destroyer, USS Ted Stevens (DDG 128), into active commission today during a formal ceremony in Whittier, Alaska. The commissioning of USS Ted Stevens marks an immediate, decisive leap in naval warfighting readiness and surface fleet lethality.

evidenceRecords.text: Navy has officially commissioned the USS Ted Stevens (DDG 128), its newest Flight III Arleigh Burke-class guided-missile destroyer equipped with the SPY-6 radar and Aegis Baseline 10, during a ceremony in Whittier, Alaska.
US Navy press release The U.S.
Navy placed its newest Flight III Arleigh Burke-class guided-missile destroyer, USS Ted Stevens (DDG 128), into active commission today during a formal ceremony in Whittier, Alaska.

As the second Flight III destroyer to enter active service, USS Ted Stevens provides combatant commanders with unmatched integrated air and missile defense capabilities, directly supporting Department of War priorities to enforce maritime dominance, secure contested sea lanes, and project credible deterrence worldwide.
The commissioning of the USS Ted Stevens (DDG 128) underscores the Navy’s commitment to building America’s Golden Fleet.
The commissioning of USS Ted Stevens marks an immediate, decisive leap in naval warfighting readiness and surface fleet lethality.
“To my crew, my shipmates, the men and women who are the heart and soul of this great ship, you have exceeded all expectations,” said U.S.
Navy Capt.
Mary Katey Hayes, commanding officer of USS Ted Stevens. “We are ready to answer our nation’s call.
We are ready to defend freedom, whether the winds of war blow near the rugged coast of Alaska, or in the far reaches of the globe.”

USS Ted Stevens is built around the AN/SPY-6(V)1 Air and Missile Defense Radar (AMDR) and Aegis Baseline 10 combat system, delivering a generational leap in simultaneous Anti-Air Warfare (AAW) and Ballistic Missile Defense (BMD).

Featuring enhanced electrical power distribution and expanded cooling capacity, the destroyer is engineered to operate in high-threat environments and integrate seamlessly with joint and coalition forces.
For 250 years, American naval power has projected strength globally.

items.summary: We have a significant update on the fast-moving world of Collaborative Combat Aircraft (CCA) out of Mojave, California today. Northrop Grumman’s Talon Blue, which now has the official designation YFQ-48A, has taken to the skies for the first time. Talon Blue flying out of Mojave Air and Space Port for the first time. (@Task_Force23) TASK_FORCE23 The uncrewed aircraft took to the skies over Mojave Air and Space Port, home of famed ‘bleeding0edge’ airframer and Northrop Grumman subsidiary Scaled Composites, which built the aircraft.

Talon Blue flying out of Mojave Air and Space Port for the first time. (@Task_Force23) TASK_FORCE23 The uncrewed aircraft took to the skies over Mojave Air and Space Port, home of famed ‘bleeding0edge’ airframer and Northrop Grumman subsidiary Scaled Composites, which built the aircraft.
3, 2026 – Northrop Grumman’s (NYSE: NOC) YFQ-48A Talon Blue completed its first fully autonomous flight, including taxi, takeoff, in-flight maneuvers, and landing.
The flight builds on Northrop Grumman’s seven decades of autonomy experience and more than 500,000 autonomous flight hours, with lessons from Talon Blue informing future autonomous systems.

Details on YFQ-48A Talon Blue: Talon Blue is part of Northrop Grumman’s internally-funded Project Talon portfolio focused on accelerating the development of mission-ready autonomous airpower capabilities.

Every flight and lesson strengthens our broader autonomy work and sharpens what comes next.” Talon Blue flying above the Mojave Desert in California. (Northrop Grumman) While the Talon Blue aircraft draws most of the attention, Northrop Grumman has put great emphasis on its back-end autonomy development ecosystem, which includes its purpose-built Model 437 demonstrator aircraft , now under the Talon IQ badge (formerly Beacon).

Talon Blue is entering a growing field of CCA offerings, with extremely intense competition, that are primarily aimed at equipping the USAF with its next CCA acquisition of hundreds of aircraft known as Increment 2 , for which the requirements remain undefined.

Many more types are on the horizon, including those from new players and globally from foreign manufacturers . (@Task_Force23) TASK_FORCE23 (@Task_Force23) TASK_FORCE23 With the loss of the F/A-XX next-generation naval fighter program to Boeing, Northrop Grumman winning a contract from the U.S. services for Talon Blue has become more important.

items.title: Germany's Merz arrives in Kyiv to pledge more support
items.originalTitle: Germany's Merz arrives in Kyiv to pledge more support
items.summary: German Chancellor Friedrich Merz arrived in the Ukrainian capital, Kyiv, on Sunday morning, accompanied by Economy Minister Katherina Reiche and a delegation of leading German economic figures. Merz is also expected to unveil plans for the co-production of interceptor drones and long-range missiles both in Ukraine and Germany. Merz is expected to emphasize how Germany also stands to benefit from the expanded cooperation, both in terms of its own defense against Russian hybrid activities and in terms of jobs and technology.

evidenceRecords.text: German Chancellor Friedrich Merz arrived in the Ukrainian capital, Kyiv, on Sunday morning, accompanied by Economy Minister Katherina Reiche and a delegation of leading German economic figures.
Merz is also expected to unveil plans for the co-production of interceptor drones and long-range missiles both in Ukraine and Germany.
Merz is expected to emphasize how Germany also stands to benefit from the expanded cooperation, both in terms of its own defense against Russian hybrid activities and in terms of jobs and technology.
Merz's arrival in Kyiv marks the fourth such visit to Ukraine by a German chancellor since the full-scale Russian invasion began in February 2022.
His predecessor, Olaf Scholz, visited twice during his three-year tenure, while Merz himself first traveled to Kyiv in May 2025 – just four days after taking office.
He was accompanied on that occasion by French President Emmanuel Macron, Polish Prime Minister Donald Tusk and former British Prime Minister Keir Starmer.
Sunday's visit comes just days after Merz had assured Ukraine of Germany's support, despite isolated resistance and criticism at home.
In his speech on Thursday, Merz called out in particular "the AfD and their Russian backers" and promised Ukraine that Germany would not be divided.

items.title: OpenAI safety employee resigns, claiming the company’s ‘culture is broken’
items.originalTitle: OpenAI safety employee resigns, claiming the company’s ‘culture is broken’
items.summary: In an essay published in The Atlantic, Robinson said he led the writing of safety reports that accompanied OpenAI’s major product launches. He also said that with three-and-a-half years at OpenAI, he is “among the longest-tenured employees at the company.” Now he’s quitting, because in his view, the company’s “culture is broken.” But in Robinson’s view, the debate needs to go beyond “specific rules or new laws,” addressing the overall culture at these companies.

evidenceRecords.text: In an essay published in The Atlantic, Robinson said he led the writing of safety reports that accompanied OpenAI’s major product launches.
He also said that with three-and-a-half years at OpenAI, he is “among the longest-tenured employees at the company.” Now he’s quitting, because in his view, the company’s “culture is broken.”
But in Robinson’s view, the debate needs to go beyond “specific rules or new laws,” addressing the overall culture at these companies.

And while much of the reporting around OpenAI has focused on how the company’s CEO Sam Altman lost the trust of former colleagues, Robinson’s essay suggests that OpenAI’s culture issues are the same as those of Silicon Valley at large.
In response to Robinson’s essay, OpenAI spokesperson Drew Pusateri said the company continues to improve its safety measures.

“Perhaps I should have stayed and fought for fundamental shifts in our staffing and culture, but in practice, my colleagues and I were so busy sprinting that we seldom had the chance to consider big changes, much less to actually make them,” Robinson said. “That’s why I concluded that stronger incentives for safety — coming from outside the company — are a big part of getting this right.”

He also said that with three-and-a-half years at OpenAI, he is “among the longest-tenured employees at the company.” Now he’s quitting, because in his view, the company’s “culture is broken.” But in Robinson’s view, the debate needs to go beyond “specific rules or new laws,” addressing the overall culture at these companies.

events.title: 乌克兰称首次实战使用FP-7弹道导弹
events.summary: 乌克兰表示已首次在实战中使用其国产FP-7战术弹道导弹。乌克兰总统泽连斯基宣布，乌方完成了由乌克兰防务公司Fire Point研制的地面发射弹道导弹FP-7的首次作战使用。Fire Point自俄罗斯全面入侵以来迅速扩张，最初从无人机起步，随后进入远程打击导弹和弹道导弹技术领域。据乌克兰及该公司发布的信息，FP-7射程约250公里（155英里），弹头重约150公斤（331磅）。值得注意的是，Fire Point还将FP-7的基本导弹架构用于另一种武器，即由地对地FP-7衍生的FP-7.X反导拦截弹。该公司期望两套…

events.title: “这是恐怖主义”：俄罗斯白天空袭基辅科学院
events.summary: 周一，一架俄罗斯无人机击中基辅市中心的乌克兰国家科学院，造成至少一人死亡，这是对乌克兰首都的最新一次白天袭击。一名人士表示：“我们与军方没有关系。这是对科学的攻击。这是恐怖主义。”他担心一些同事可能仍被困在科学院内。

events.title: 波音获首份全速生产“灰狼”直升机订单，迎大单周
events.summary: 波音公司周四表示，美国空军又订购了4架MH-139A“灰狼”直升机，这是该机型首份全速生产订单，距美空军宣布该机已具备执行核导弹安保任务的能力仅数周。波音发言人对《防务新闻》称，这份“灰狼”合同价值约8500万美元，包含部分保障工作，于9月25日授予，公司预计2028年或2029年交付这4架直升机。波音防务、空间与安全部门垂直起降项目副总裁兼总经理凯瑟琳·若利韦特在公司新闻稿中称，这一里程碑验证了“灰狼”的关键就绪水平，并支持该军种在战略导弹基地部署以保护重要国家资产的计划。1月8日，第40直升机中队的两架“灰狼…

events.title: 以色列对加沙袭击致七人死亡，“停火”违规持续
events.summary: 在以色列继续违反已持续近一年的“停火”之际，加沙地带至少七名巴勒斯坦人在以色列袭击中丧生，十多人受伤。半岛电视台记者欣德·胡达里从加沙城报道称，医生表示由于多年以色列袭击和封锁使医疗系统遭到摧毁，挽救伤者生命十分困难。她还表示，此次袭击的死亡人数未来数小时可能上升。胡达里说，加沙本应实现停火，但以色列军队的暴力没有尽头，巴勒斯坦人每天都在被杀、受伤，人道局势不断恶化，加沙居民的生存条件“可怕”。
events.outlook: 继续观察新的独立来源与正式信息。

events.title: 巨大飞跃：研究人员在轨演示可编程量子光子处理器
events.summary: 研究人员在轨运行了一台可编程量子光子处理器，演示了双光子干涉，作为迈向星载量子计算的早期一步。该处理器在六路径光路中操纵两个光子，但探测器故障、辐射损伤和阳光相关噪声限制了其性能。研究人员已在轨运行一台可编程量子光子处理器，展示了一种基于光的计算能力，最终可能帮助卫星在将数据传回地球之前进行分析。
events.outlook: 继续观察新的独立来源与正式信息。

events.title: 沙特计划对胡塞武装发动攻势，以打破红海封锁
events.summary: 据地区与西方国家官员向路透社透露，沙特阿拉伯正计划对也门境内由伊朗支持的胡塞武装发动攻势，目前正在考虑多种方案。选项包括沿红海海岸推进以保障红海航运路线，或在多条战线同时发起进攻。报道未说明行动的具体时间表或最终是否实施。
events.outlook: 后续可观察沙特官方或军方是否就相关方案公开表态，以及红海航运与也门沿岸军事态势是否出现可核实变化。

events.title: Neros与Perennial Autonomy在五角大楼无人机竞赛中领先
events.summary: 两家总部位于加利福尼亚州的初创公司在“无人机优势”竞赛最新阶段中名列前茅，该竞赛是五角大楼为寻找能够大规模生产高质量、低成本商用无人机的企业而开展的。根据竞赛排行榜，Neros Technologies在受限环境测试类别中得分最高。Perennial Autonomy在“深度打击”测试中位居第一，该测试要求操作员在敌方防御范围之外发起攻击。五角大楼利用这些公司的排名来决定采购多少架无人机，这意味着得分越高的公司获得越大的订单。总体而言，五角大楼向Neros订购了14000架无人机——该公司在深度打击测试中也排名第…
